out.finalReply:
Hi Tomas,

You can reset your HomeFix network password from your phone without a company laptop. The self-service reset site works from any browser and off the company network.

1. Go to reset.homefixsupply.com from your phone browser.
2. Enter your employee email and select “Send verification code.”
3. Enter the 6-digit code sent to your registered mobile number.
4. Choose a new password with at least 14 characters, including at least one number and one symbol. It cannot match your last 10 passwords.

After the reset, the new password syncs to email, VPN, and the HR portal within 5 minutes.

If you have not registered a mobile number, self-service reset will not work; please call the IT service desk at extension 4357 for identity verification.

Best regards,
HomeFix Supply Support Team
out.recommendedApproach: Approve the draft as-is; it answers the phone/off-network reset and sync questions using the password reset KB. No escalation is needed unless Tomas reports that he lacks a registered mobile number or cannot receive the verification code; in that case, direct him to the IT service desk at extension 4357 for identity verification. Verify only that the customer’s mobile number is registered if he follows up with a reset failure.
out.reviewerNote: Approved as-is: grounded self-service reset steps; answers both the phone/off-network and the sync questions. Only follow up if he has no registered mobile number.
